tooling.message:
docs(arc42): quality goals grounded in the platform design, metrics with their source

## Intent

The quality goals of the tooling should rest on the platform design. Other agents cannot be measured directly, so every scenario needs a number from a source that can actually be observed.

## Key changes

- Chapter 10 has seven goals, each quoting the part of the platform design it rests on, and thirteen scenarios.
- A new section says how the scenarios are measured: evals, listing reports, the plan's retrospective, conversations with creators.
- The plan records KD-16 and KD-17 (retrospective in the plan file); agent feedback is deferred to #8.
